summary: Fortress Private Lending Fund filed an 8-K to report an unregistered sale of 1,004,122 Class I common shares at $24.01 per share (March 31, 2026 NAV), raising $24.1 million in aggregate. The sale was made to accredited investors under Section 4(a)(2) and Regulation D. The filing also disclosed a monthly distribution of $0.1715 per share and a portfolio commentary with $1.7 billion fair value across 87 companies, 97.9% first lien, 99.9% floating rate. This is a routine capital raise and operational update, not a special situation.
